none: PAS BUC-27397D: Roman Coin : Denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES NER OPTIM AVG GERM DAC ; R/ PARTHICO P M TR P COS VI P P S P Q R

A silver denarius of Trajan. Reece period: 5 [96-117]. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES NER OPTIM AVG GERM DAC. Reverse description: Mars standing right. Reverse inscription: PARTHICO P M TR P COS VI P P S P Q R. Mint of Rome. AD 114-117. RIC III, p. 268, no. 334
